messages:
Alex: Heads up — promo is blocked by deploy-bot, artifact verify failing in staging.
Deploy Bot: Promotion blocked: artifact-verify failed for registry.redwood/internal-service:canary (checksum mismatch). See run: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/5821 :warning:
Sam: getting 503s and truncated multipart uploads from the registry during the artifact push window.
Jen: logs show `upload error: EOF after 24576/1048576` and then checksum mismatch on verify. Reproducer attached in the job artifacts.
CI-Bot: Pipeline #5821: integration tests flaky — test_suite::session_timeout on node-3. Re-ran twice, same failure.
Mallory: change window in ~40m. Options: pin to last-known-good digest and promote now, or rebuild (cache-bust) and re-run full smoke + e2e (30-45m).
Alex: Product wants the patch out sooner if safe — leaning to pin unless ops says unsafe.
Sam: If we pin we need explicit rollback steps and release note. Also risk of masking GC/registry issue.
Jen: I tried a re-run with `CI_SKIP_CACHE=1` to force fresh upload. Upload completed but deploy-bot still reports checksum mismatch — looks like verification reads inconsistent blobs.
Registry-SRE: (bot) We observed concurrent GC on registry cluster during that time window, which can cause transient missing blobs until GC stabilizes. We paused GC and are doing consistency checks now.
Mallory: Given that, pin makes sense to unblock customers. We'll follow up with a rebuild once registry is stable.
Dana (PM): Agree on pin+postmortem. Customers impacted by this release are on the critical path.
Alex: Proposed plan: 1) Pin to last-good digest (sha256:abc123def456...), 2) Merge PR + manual promote, 3) Post-release rebuild with cache-bust and verification, 4) Postmortem and release-note entry.
Jen: I'll open the pin PR now and include the digest and CI guard.
Mallory: I'll draft the release note blurb and include rollback instructions: revert PR and re-promote previous digest.
Sam: After PR merges I'll run the promote with manual approval flags and monitor telemetry.
Deploy Bot: Promotion requires approval: manual promotion blocked until @Alex and @Mallory approve.
Alex: Approved. :thumbsup:
Mallory: Approved. :white_check_mark:
Deploy Bot: Promotion triggered by @Sam — logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/promote/789 — status: in_progress
CI-Bot: Quick smoke and routing checks passed. e2e smoke ok (canary path).
Support-Bot: Prepared support message template: "We've pinned this release to a known-good image due to transient registry artifact verification issues; follow-up patch incoming."
Jen: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood/internal/PR/432 — includes digest pin and CI_SKIP_CACHE toggle for the rebuild run.
Sam: Promote finished: success. Prod traffic routing updated. Observability looks normal.
Mallory: Release notes updated in the release doc: short blurb + link to follow-up issue ENGINFRA-2197.
Alex: Filing a follow-up: re-run full build+verify after registry GC finished and close with a postmortem. I'll assign ENGINFRA and infra oncall.
Mallory: I'll own the postmortem writeup and link the artifacts.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open for the postmortem artifacts; closing after that.
